title: 75 hotter 🎧🩰💌💞💋
author: Adam Rowland
desc:
🍑  this three-day programme is designed to build overall strength while prioritising glute size, projection and shelf development 🍑 

💖 stable, supported exercises improve joint control and balance, making it suitable for a beginner  💖

🌱 back, shoulder and arm training supports posture and definition, while progressive overload encourages steady muscle growth  🌱

❤️‍🔥 paired with consistent nutrition and recovery, it supports a smaller waist appearance, stronger curves and long-term body recomposition ❤️‍🔥

ex.note: rest the upper back on the bench and drive the hips upwards by squeezing the glutes 🍑
pull the handle towards the lower ribs while keeping the torso still 🚣‍♂️
curl the heels backwards, squeeze the hamstrings and return slowly 🦵
raise the dumbbells sideways to approximately shoulder height with soft elbows 🦋🪽
extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back against the floor 🧘‍♀️
keep the knees slightly bent and push the bum backwards until the hamstrings feel stretched 🍑🍑
lower the dumbbells beside the chest and press upwards and together 💪💪
pull the bar or rope towards the upper chest while keeping the ribs controlled 🪽🪽
curl the dumbbells towards the shoulders without moving the upper arms 🌸💪
keep the elbows beside the body and straighten the arms without forcing lockout 💅💪
go lighter on this day, drive the hips upwards and hold the glute squeeze for one second 🍑 🍑
move the leg backwards and slightly outwards without rotating the pelvis 👠 👠
move the leg directly sideways while keeping the pelvis level 👙🍑
pull towards the upper chest with the elbows travelling slightly outwards 🎀🪽
sit with the back supported and press the dumbbells overhead without shrugging or forcing the elbows into lockout 👑💖
press the rope down and separate its ends without hyperextending the elbows 💅💪
